wins: Achieved maximum reward of 37.5 in the single episode by successfully reaching the mid-stage reconnaissance checkpoint despite incomplete mission success.
Maintained consistent mentor guidance (15 calls) to capture tactical adjustments, indicating strong situational awareness and responsiveness.
fails: Success rate remains at 0% due to failure to complete the final objective, indicating a recurring inability to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation.
No automated exploit paths were finalized, leading to mission termination before persistence or data capture phases.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed effectively, but the run repeatedly stalls before exploitation, resulting in zero mission successes despite high reward accumulation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to pivot from initial port enumeration to targeted exploitation, leaving services unexploited despite reconnaissance data.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service lists directory indexing and a login form is present
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke wget/curl to fetch directory listing and brute-force login with curated password list

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance identifies exposed file shares or SMB services
skill_cards.then_action: Launch smbclient enumeration followed by targeted credential spraying

memory_ops.reason: High utility during initial SSH reconnaissance; consistently enabled follow-on observations.
Directory and login discovery path surfaced repeatedly, justifying focused exploitation.
